title: Lever Jobs Scraper Input
description: Collect open postings from Lever job boards by company slug, board URL, API URL or posting URL. Global and EU boards are supported; all filters run on the complete board data.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Fetch every open posting from one or more boards, or fetch specific postings by ID or URL.
enumTitles: Get all postings from boards or URLs
Get specific postings by ID or URL

companySlugs.title: Companies (mode=getJobs)
companySlugs.description: Company slugs, board URLs, API URLs or posting URLs. Examples: "wealthfront", "https://jobs.lever.co/wealthfront", "https://jobs.eu.lever.co/olx", "https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/wealthfront".

companySlug.title: Company (mode=getJob)
companySlug.description: Company slug, board URL, API URL or posting URL used with postingIds (mode=getJob).

boardRegion.title: Lever region
boardRegion.description: Use auto to try the global board first and fall back to the EU board when global returns 404 or no postings.

team.title: Team
team.description: Keep postings whose team contains this text (case-insensitive).

department.title: Department
department.description: Keep postings whose department contains this text (case-insensitive).

location.title: Location
location.description: Keep postings whose primary location or any additional location contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. "London" or "Remote".

commitment.title: Commitment
commitment.description: Keep postings whose commitment or normalized employment type matches this text, e.g. "Full-time", "Contract", "Internship".

workplaceType.title: Workplace type
workplaceType.description: Keep postings with this exact workplace arrangement.

remoteOnly.title: Remote only
remoteOnly.description: Keep only postings marked remote or with a remote location.

country.title: Country
country.description: Keep postings for one ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "US", "DE" or "IN".

titleKeywords.title: Title must include
titleKeywords.description: Keep postings whose title contains every word in this list, in any order.

excludeTitleKeywords.title: Title must not include
excludeTitleKeywords.description: Drop postings whose title contains any word in this list.

postedAfter.title: Posted after
postedAfter.description: Keep postings created on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

hasSalaryOnly.title: Has salary only
hasSalaryOnly.description: Keep only postings with a structured salary range published by Lever.

salaryMin.title: Minimum salary
salaryMin.description: Keep postings whose structured salary range starts at or above this value (same currency and interval as the posting).

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of posting records to emit.

maxItemsPerCompany.title: Max items per company
maxItemsPerCompany.description: Maximum records per company board; 0 means no per-company limit.

includeDescription.title: Include descriptions
includeDescription.description: Include full and section descriptions plus requirement lists.

includeHtml.title: Include HTML
includeHtml.description: Add the original HTML for descriptions, additional text and list content.

onlyNewSinceLastRun.title: Only new since last run
onlyNewSinceLastRun.description: Emit only postings not seen by an earlier run with the same query shape. The first run returns everything.
